description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A rectangular breakfast tray with raised side rails and two integrated hand slots. Side: Two hinged U-shaped bamboo legs fold beneath the tray. Rear: Rear corner joints show wrapped bindings and plain concealed hinge hardware. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
